nodes.title: Radar public teardown (account-free): 59 graded claims on ~40 vendors outside the deep set (35 observed, 12 vendor-claimed, 10 inferred, 2 unknown), from 52 passive page loads plus docs indexes, pricing pages, PyPI JSON and press pages, sha256 manifest of 282 raw files under data/teardown/radar.

Inference: radar table of 44 vendors scored with a proposed rubric (buyer overlap x3, Indian telephony x2, Indic evidence x2, price, self-serve, momentum). Top: Gupshup Voice AI 4, Ringg 4, Smallest 4, Gnani 4; Desible flagged for the renewal beachhead despite scoring 3; Air.ai dropped (exited).
Proposed: swap Synthflow out of the deep set for Gupshup Voice AI; Ringg first alternate, Smallest second; Gnani, Desible and Navana covered desk-deep plus buyer interviews (no trial exists).
nodes.rationale: Synthflow is enterprise-only from USD 30k/yr (pricing-history Sep-Oct 2026), so the account phase cannot run time-and-motion on it. Gupshup launched a self-serve console on 2026-09-04 with 100 free minutes, 'from INR 3.50/min', owned Indian numbers via Knowlarity and WhatsApp in the same agent, and sells to the Indian enterprises that already buy its messaging.
nodes.reverse_if: Gupshup sign-up turns out not to be self-serve (sales gate or KYC beyond email/phone OTP), or its trial cannot place a call to an Indian PSTN number, or Synthflow restores a self-serve plan, or 3+ buyer interviews say Gupshup is not on their evaluation list while Synthflow is.

nodes.title: BFSI specialists funded in the window, one naming our beachhead: Desible.ai (INR 32 Cr seed-plus, 2026-10-07) lists a 'Policy Renewal Agent' and an 'Insurance Post-Sales & Onboarding Agent' on its homepage (observed); Navana (INR 40 Cr Series A, 2026-09-07) claims 100M+ BFSI minutes (vendor-claimed); Gnani publishes no price (observed) and claims 12M+ renewals. None offers a trial.

Inference: Indian sellers are packaging the operation rather than the tool. MyOperator withdrew its INR 5/min AI plan for a custom plan with a human 'AI Agent Manager' (observed); Samora escalates to trained human operators; Tata/TTBS and Caller.digital price per outcome (vendor-claimed). Candidate 'where we win': make the agent manager's job (find failed calls, explain, propose and test the fix) a measurable product.

Inference: two features moved into the parity floor. Pre-deployment simulation/evals ship at Gupshup, Cartesia, LiveKit, PolyAI, ThunderPhone and Ringg (often free) and are sold standalone by Coval and Hamming; voice plus WhatsApp in one agent is at 6+ radar vendors, extending l4a's 'only Ringg and ElevenLabs'.

Caller.digital publishes its per-minute INR stack: Growth INR 10.15 = carrier 1.04 + STT 0.73 + LLM 0.62 + TTS 1.68 + server 0.84 + LiveKit 0.14 + support 2.10 + platform fee 3.00 (PAYG BYOK 9.42). AI layers are INR 3.02; support plus platform fee are about half the price. Contradicts ledger CMP-16 (INR 3-8 + 1-3 lakh/month).

Indian self-serve headline floor is INR 3.50/min from two vendors (Sarvam PAYG + INR 0.40 telephony; Gupshup 'from INR 3.50', telephony inclusion not stated); Ringg INR 6 all-in unchanged; global per-minute brains at 2 cents (PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 API + tokens; ThunderPhone) and GPT-Live-1 at USD 0.05 flat.
PyPI releases 2026-04-20..10-20: bolna 297 (0.10.306 on 10-20), livekit-agents 41 (1.8.8 on 10-15, 2.0.0b1), sarvamai 48, pipecat-ai 15 (1.13.0 on 10-19, superseding l7's 1.12.0).
nodes.n: 4 packages; every version with an uploaded file in the window
nodes.method: pypi.org/pypi/<pkg>/json fetched 2026-10-20; per version, earliest upload_time_iso_8601 >= 2026-04-20 counted

nodes.title: Carriers and CPaaS move up into agents with owned numbers, bundled billing and existing enterprise contracts: Gupshup + Knowlarity (self-serve, Sep 2026), Tata Communications + TTBS (SMB, outcome-priced, Sep 2026), Exotel AgentStream, and Plivo marketing (unverified, pages now 404).
nodes.mitigation: Stay carrier-agnostic: BYOT for Exotel, Plivo, Vobiz, Tata and Ozonetel from v1, so a buyer's existing carrier is never the reason to choose a bundle. Compete on measured call quality and the operator layer, not on price or number supply. Re-triage weekly via watchlist.json.

nodes.title: REA inspect-web-network-capture as the radar's stack-identification step.
nodes.tried: npx rea-agents@6.7.0 inspect-web-network-capture <Playwright 1.56 HAR> har on the Ozonetel homepage capture (262 entries).
nodes.broke: First run rejected the whole HAR because one Facebook-pixel URL had unescaped '[' (strict 'uri' format). After percent-encoding 4 URLs in a copy it returned a 1.3 MB lossless evidence record (sha256, redaction, limitations) but no provider or stack classification, so it adds provenance, not inference. Stack signals came from our own host classification.

nodes.title: What does Gupshup Voice AI's 'from INR 3.50/min' include (telephony, LLM, TTS), how fast are Knowlarity numbers provisioned with DLT/140/160 handling, does Hindi/Hinglish hold on our caller battery, does it disclose being an AI, and is the 'mhm vs cut-in' claim true?
nodes.closes_when: An account-phase trial (100 free minutes) yields an itemised usage/invoice line, a provisioned Indian number with its compliance steps recorded, and the l4b caller battery run to our Plivo number with reply gap, cut-ins, language hold and disclosure scored.

nodes.title: Desible, Navana and Gnani cannot be trialled. Do insurance and BFSI ops leads use or evaluate them for renewals, at what price, and where do they fail?
nodes.closes_when: At least 5 of the 10-15 founder-kit buyer interviews cover these three vendors by name, with price paid (or quoted), use case, and the failure mode that made them switch or hesitate.

nodes.title: Weekly change-watch: 67 URLs (59 deep-set pricing/changelog/llms.txt/sitemap/status/PyPI/npm + 8 radar) with baseline sha256 and a diff method each, 9 new-entrant sweep sources (5 reachable from the sandbox), the triage rubric with promote rule and re-triage triggers, and the probe scripts.
nodes.value: Turns the radar into a scheduled diff: a new price, changelog entry, status incident or funded entrant surfaces within a week without re-researching the field.
nodes.effort: Low: curl + text diff, about 3 minutes per weekly run; no accounts.

events.details: Radar lane (account-free) finished. Scanned 52 public pages passively with Playwright (no clicks, sign-ups or forms), fetched docs indexes, pricing pages, PyPI/npm JSON, status endpoints and press pages, and swept new entrants since 2026-04 via HN Algolia, Inc42, YourStory and web search. Wrote radar.csv (44 rows, rubric-scored), claims.json (59 graded claims), watchlist.json (67 URLs + sweep sources + rubric) and a sha256 manifest of 282 raw files. Proposed swapping Synthflow for Gupshup Voice AI in the deep set. REA HAR inspection needed URL sanitisation and gave no stack inference. knowlarity.com TLS failed and was not bypassed. report.md was refused by the subagent harness; its text went back in the structured output.
